page.description: URL or id of the page to read. Leave out to read the open page.

part.description: Which part of a long page to read, starting at 1.

database.description: Id or URL of the database. Leave out for the open page.

property.description: Property name, as the result lists it.

value.description: What to compare with; not needed for is_empty and is_not_empty.

part.description: Which part of a long result, starting at 1.

page.description: URL or id of a page to list the pages under. Leave out for the top level.

section.description: Without `page`: list only this top-level section, by its name as a list showed it (say "Private", or a teamspace's name).

depth.description: With `page` or `section`: how many levels to list. Defaults to 1, the only depth without them.

offset.description: With `page` or `section`: skip this many entries of the top level, to see what a cut-off list left out. Entries include blocks that are not listed (text, say), so use the offset a cut-off list gives.

page.description: Id of the page to edit, as read_page shows it after "Page:".

block.description: Reference of the block, as read_page shows it (e.g. ^1a2b3c4d). For insert: the block to insert after, or inside.

position.description: For insert: after `block` (the default when `block` is given); inside `block`, nested in it before what it already holds; or at the start or end of the page.

markdown.description: For insert and replace: the new content, as Markdown.

title.description: The new page's title, on one line: inline Markdown as query_database and read_page show text (bold, links, `[Title](page id)`, `@[Name]`, `@2026-11-20`): put a backslash before a character that must stay literal, and write a backslash itself as \\.

markdown.description: The page's content, as Markdown. Leave out for an empty page.

parent.description: URL or id of the page or database to create it in.

properties.description:
Database properties by name: text, a number, Yes/No for checkboxes, an option name (a list for multi-select), or a date as YYYY-MM-DD (a range as "YYYY-MM-DD → YYYY-MM-DD"). Empty clears a value. The title goes in `title`, not here. Setting a date replaces any time or reminder it had. A text property is inline Markdown as query_database and read_page show text (bold, links, `[Title](page id)`, `@[Name]`, `@2026-11-20`): put a backslash before a character that must stay literal, and write a backslash itself as \\; a line break in it is `
`. In other values, Markdown escapes are undone.

page.description: Id or URL of the page or row.

title.description: A new title, on one line: inline Markdown as query_database and read_page show text (bold, links, `[Title](page id)`, `@[Name]`, `@2026-11-20`): put a backslash before a character that must stay literal, and write a backslash itself as \\.

properties.description:
Database properties by name: text, a number, Yes/No for checkboxes, an option name (a list for multi-select), or a date as YYYY-MM-DD (a range as "YYYY-MM-DD → YYYY-MM-DD"). Empty clears a value. The title goes in `title`, not here. Setting a date replaces any time or reminder it had. A text property is inline Markdown as query_database and read_page show text (bold, links, `[Title](page id)`, `@[Name]`, `@2026-11-20`): put a backslash before a character that must stay literal, and write a backslash itself as \\; a line break in it is `
`. In other values, Markdown escapes are undone.

parent.description: URL or id of the page to create it in.

title.description: The database's name. Markdown escapes are undone: write a backslash itself as \\.

title_property.description: The name of the title column. Default: Name.

name.description: The property's name. Markdown escapes are undone: write a backslash itself as \\.

options.description: For select and multi_select: the options' names, without commas. A status gets Notion's own.

database.description: Id or URL of the database. Leave out for the open page.

property.description: The property to change, or to add.

options.description: For add_property and add_options: option names.

option.description: For rename_option and remove_option: the option.

to.description: For the renames: the new name. Markdown escapes are undone: write a backslash itself as \\.

pages.description: Ids or URLs of the pages to move.

to.description: Id or URL of the page to move them into.

page.description: Id or URL of the page to duplicate.

pages.description: Ids or URLs of the pages to trash.

limit.description: How many pages to return, up to 20. Defaults to 10.

page.description: URL or id of the page. Leave out for the open page.

part.description: Which part of many comments to read, starting at 1.

page.description: URL or id of the page, as read_page shows it after "Page:".

block.description: Reference of the block to comment on. Leave out for the page itself.
